seo.title: Mai Mohamed — Product Analyst / Owner
seo.description: Mai Mohamed is a Product Analyst / Owner in Cairo working across product analytics, market research, and product management.

hero.statement: I turn user behaviour into product decisions.
hero.supporting: I work across product analytics, market research, and product management. I analyse how people move through apps and funnels, research the markets behind them, and write the user stories and specs that get features built.

work.title: Selected work
work.intro: Four engagements across analytics, research, and product. Each one has its own case study.

approach.title: My approach
approach.intro: Four steps, from behaviour to a decision the team can act on.

contact.title: Let’s talk.
contact.intro: Send a message using the form, or reach me directly.

paragraphs: I'm Mai Mohamed, a Product Analyst / Owner based in Cairo. My background is in business administration (Cairo University, English section), and my work has moved from social media and customer service into research, analytics, and product.

Since 2021 I have analysed websites and apps with GA, GA4, Airbridge, and Microsoft Clarity, researched markets across Egypt and Saudi Arabia, and written user stories and acceptance criteria for development teams.

approach.title: Understand the behaviour
approach.body: How users move through the product, including sessions, funnels, and drop-offs.

approach.title: Check the market and the customer
approach.body: Pair the numbers with research on competitors, consumer needs, and customer feedback.

approach.title: Turn it into clear requirements
approach.body: Write user stories and acceptance criteria developers can build from, and keep documentation current.

approach.title: Measure and report
approach.body: Track KPIs in dashboards and report results so product and marketing teams can act on them.
